summary: Iteration 110 — verified B2B waitlist admin-notification bugfix. 9/9 executed tests pass; 3 skipped for principled reasons (live Appyflow blocks the synthetic test GSTIN before the email path runs; the same code branches are covered by in-process monkeypatched tests). Core invariant confirmed: POST /api/retailer-auth/waitlist now ALWAYS persists `email_notifications` {admin, applicant, error} + `email_notifications_at` on the retailer_waitlist document, so silent Resend failures can no longer masquerade as a successful notification. Positive path with live RESEND_API_KEY records admin=True. Anti-spoofing regression intact (legal-name, state, pincode mismatches → 400). Provider-down soft-pass still works and records notifications. GSTIN retailer login regression passes.

action_items: Production (Render) redeploy: the code fix is verified in preview; user-facing 'pseudo-onboard' on production is now impossible because email_notifications is always persisted, BUT production Render deployment still needs the new commit AND correct env vars (RESEND_API_KEY, ADMIN_EMAIL, SENDER_EMAIL with a verified domain). Instruct user to redeploy and verify a test signup: check the retailer_waitlist doc in production Mongo for email_notifications.admin==true; if false, error field will now explicitly say what's wrong.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix correctly captures send_email return values into email_status and persists via a follow-up update_one — the outcome can never again be silently swallowed.

Nit (non-blocking): admin_html builds `wa.me/{cc.lstrip('+')}{phone}` via nested f-string quotes (line 344). Works on Py3.12+ but on older Python may need braces care. Confirmed running on 3.11 without issue.

Nit: `email_status` variable is reused as both the send-result dict AND the condition source for setting `error` message when admin is False — semantics fine but consider renaming `email_status['error']` set-on-admin-false vs set-on-exception for clearer post-mortems.

Consider adding an alert/log-metric hook when email_notifications.admin==False AND provider was expected up — right now it's only logger.error, easy to miss on Render's tail. A Sentry breadcrumb or a Mongo `admin_alerts` collection row would be safer for production.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bugfix verified. Note that Appyflow live rejects synthetic GSTINs including 07AAAAA0000A1Z5, so raw HTTP tests exercising the waitlist positive path with that GSTIN will 400. To test the positive path programmatically, use in-process TestClient/ASGITransport and monkeypatch services.gst_verification.verify_gst_number (endpoint imports lazily so module-attr patching works). Do NOT touch backend/.env — subprocess-based env override is the way to test misconfigured Resend.
rca of the issue: Original bug: send_email failures inside the waitlist notification try/except were silently logged and lost — a Resend misconfiguration on Render therefore looked exactly like a successful admin notification, producing the 'pseudo-onboard' user report. Fix (routers/b2b_waitlist.py): capture send_email return bools into an email_status dict and, after the try/except, unconditionally update_one the waitlist doc with email_notifications + email_notifications_at. Tests confirm the dict lands in Mongo, the admin endpoint surfaces it, and the diagnostic error string is populated whenever admin==False. The production 'no email' symptom is now impossible to hide — main agent's action item is to ensure Render redeploys and has the correct env vars.
